name: xdex-ui
description: A science fiction desktop running everywhere. Awesome.

scripts.install-linux: npm install && cd src && npm install && ../node_modules/.bin/electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty -v 41.2.2 && cd ..
scripts.preinstall-windows: npm install --global --production windows-build-tools && npm install --global node-gyp && setx PYTHON "%USERPROFILE%\.windows-build-tools\python27\python.exe"
scripts.install-windows: npm install && cd src && npm install && ..\node_modules\.bin\electron-rebuild -f -w node-pty && cd ..
scripts.prebuild-linux: node prebuild-copy.js && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install
scripts.prebuild-darwin: node prebuild-copy.js && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install
scripts.prebuild-windows: node prebuild-copy.js && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install
scripts.test: node prebuild-copy.js && node prebuild-minify.js && cd prebuild-src && npm install && snyk test && cd .. && rm -R prebuild-src
scripts.test:unit: node --test src/tests/cve-2023-30856.test.js src/tests/file-icons-match.test.js src/tests/workspaces.test.js src/tests/ssh-profiles.test.js src/tests/plugins.test.js src/tests/ai-assistant.test.js src/tests/modules.test.js
scripts.update-file-icons: git submodule foreach git pull origin master && node file-icons-generator.js
